_schema.purpose: gwz-py's own CLI parser parity fixture: argv lists whose classification -- parses, is rejected by the parser, is refused by validation -- this driver must share with the Rust CLI. Add a case here, not in a test module.
_schema.stability: Keys are stable. Append cases; do not reorder existing ones.
_schema.local_family: The design section 7 local clone family rows -- the `CLI -> live message` table and the refusals a driver makes before encoding -- are NOT in this file. They live in the one cross-driver fixture `gwz-core/protocol/fixtures/cli_parity/local_family_cases.json` (operator ruling 1 of 2026-09-06, design section 11 item 17), which both drivers read; this file's copy of them was removed when gwz-py re-pointed at it. `src/tests/test_cli_local_family.py` asserts against that file.

argv_lists.what: Each entry is a bare argv list: no program name, no shell quoting.
argv_lists.accept: parses and validates in both drivers
argv_lists.parse_reject: rejected by the argument parser itself
argv_lists.semantic_reject: parses, then refused by validation or the command handler before any core call
argv_lists.rust_accept: flag spellings that originate in the Rust CLI and must also parse in the Python CLI
argv_lists.rust_version: argv that prints a version and exits 0
